note: Which questions this checkout of zou is measured against.
The suites are recordings of what upstream answered, so they are
upstream's data rather than zou's code and they live in their own
repository. Pinned to a commit rather than to a branch, because a
recording that moves under CI is a recording nobody is comparing
against: bumping this line is how a new suite, a re-recording, or a
pruned known list arrives, and the bump is a diff somebody reads.
